name: addsign
description: Send documents for e-signature from your AddSign templates, track who has signed, remind signers and get signed PDFs.

interface.longDescription:
AddSign is e-signature software for small businesses. Connect your AddSign account to send documents for signature from your saved templates, check who has signed, remind people who haven't, and get a download link for the signed PDF.

What you can ask:
- "List my AddSign templates"
- "Send the lease template to Maria Lopez, maria@example.com"
- "Which of my documents are still waiting for signatures?"
- "Remind the signers on the NDA I sent Monday"
- "Get me the signed copy of the Smith agreement"

How it works: you choose a template you already set up in AddSign, and the signers receive an email and sign in their browser. You confirm before anything is sent. Every document sent this way also triggers an email to you, the account owner, and is recorded in the document's audit trail.

What it can't do: it sends from your existing templates only, and it cannot cancel or delete documents, edit templates, change billing, or see API keys. To cancel a document, open it in your AddSign dashboard.

Requires an AddSign account.
capabilities: Send documents for signature from templates
Check signing status and remind signers
defaultPrompt: Which of my AddSign documents are still waiting for signatures?
Send my NDA template to a new client for signature.

positive.prompt: What AddSign templates do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's two templates by name: the mutual NDA and the Florida commercial lease.

positive.prompt: Which of my AddSign documents are still waiting for signatures?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pending documents with their signers. Signed and declined documents are not reported as pending.

positive.description: Get the signed copy of a completed document
positive.prompt: Get me a download link for my most recently signed AddSign document.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the most recently signed document and returns a time-limited download link for its signed PDF.

positive.description: Send a document from a template
positive.prompt: Send the mutual NDA template to Signer One at signer1@example.com and Signer Two at signer2@example.com. Use two email addresses you can open.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows which template goes to which two signers and asks the user to confirm before sending. After confirmation it sends, reports the new document as pending, and both signers receive a signing email.

positive.prompt: Remind the pending signers on the NDA I just sent.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to confirm, sends one reminder email to each pending signer, and reports who was reminded.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Miami tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: AddSign is not invoked; the request is outside its workflows.

negative.description: Drafting a new contract is not an AddSign action
negative.prompt: Write me a simple one-page residential lease for a Florida apartment.
negative.expected_behavior: AddSign is not invoked. ChatGPT drafts the text itself; nothing is created or sent in AddSign.

negative.prompt: Are electronic signatures legally binding in Florida?
negative.expected_behavior: AddSign is not invoked; ChatGPT answers the general question without calling any AddSign tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release. Six tools: list templates, list documents, check signing status, send for signature from a template (with a preview before sending), remind pending signers, and get a signed-PDF download link.
